latest_release.name: v0.49.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

* blob/azblob: ensure localhost port is numeric by @vangent in https://github.com/google/go-cloud/pull/3835
* blob/gcsblob: close the downloader when BeforeRead fails by @iamabhilaksh in https://github.com/google/go-cloud/pull/3834
* blob: avoid recursive read locks in ReadAll and Download by @iamabhilaksh in https://github.com/google/go-cloud/pull/3832
* blob: hold b.mu when reading default WriterOptions by @iamabhilaksh in https://github.com/google/go-cloud/pull/3833
* blob/gcsblob: remove unnecessary test by @vangent in https://github.com/google/go-cloud/pull/3836
* blob: don't hold the read lock while ListIterator.Next recurses by @iamabhilaksh in https://github.com/google/go-cloud/pull/3839
* blob/gcsblob: escape the key in DownloadAt by @iamabhilaksh in https://github.com/google/go-cloud/pull/3838


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/google/go-cloud/compare/v0.48.0...v0.49.0
